def: to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach
kjv: get an advantage, defraud, make a gain

words.word: should get an advantage of us

occurrences.text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
words: should get an advantage of us

occurrences.text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
